title: Graph tab steps: arrival, jev's view, bars, verdict, park, action, end
what:
graph/steps.js, park.js and context.js. Each step is a frame of 6-8 lines, with the rest folded:
- heading and url; time per step
- arrival: 'heading ≠ goal', 'entail 0.12 < 0.80' (the threshold from the run's graph)
- ProbBars for the top 8, then 'more… (56)'
- jev's view (context.js), folded by default: the context as jevlike sees it (192 bytes) and each option cut to 32 bytes, with collisions flagged 'tie after the cut: margin 0'
- verdict: 'top 0.41 ≥ floor 0.35 · margin 0.03 < 0.05 → asked a person' | 'picked by rule (label equals goal)' | 'only one option'
- park as an inline ask: numbered 0-based options with p; click selects, `[ answer ]`, `[ stop ]`; disabled with eidolon's reason when the run cannot resume or a child runs
- action: 'clicked "Nile River" → Nile — Wikipedia'
End, from the last jev_mark: 'arrived at "Nile" in 3 decisions, 1 asked' | 'failed: <reason>' (even when the door said completed) | 'exhausted' | 'stopped'.
tests:
steps.test.mjs over F0 a-h through W2a:
- verdict sentences
- the cut-collision flag
- case (e) reads failed despite exit 0
- case (h) shows the re-park and the escalation used
- disabled-answer reasons
